linkedin_bio: Meet Vijay Varada, the visionary inventor, storyteller, and entrepreneur at the intersection of art, design, and technology. A mechatronics engineer by choice and an entrepreneur by chance, he founded Fracktal Works at just 19 years old. With an impressive array of 3D printers catering to personal and industrial needs, Fracktal empowers customers in Medicine, Automotive, Aerospace, Architecture, Education, and more. Blending creative problem-solving, technology, and innovation, Vijay seamlessly brings together science, design, and engineering, delivering unique products and solutions. Beyond the corporate world, he actively contributes to open-source hardware projects, particularly assistive technologies for the visually impaired and renewable energy solutions, garnering acclaim and accolades, including Hackaday Prize wins in 2017 and 2018. Fueling his adventurous spirit, Vijay embarked on an expedition to Antarctica alongside the renowned polar explorer, Robert Swan. Together, they showcased the might of open-source hardware through a groundbreaking 3D Printable Wind Turbine. Not content with revolutionizing industries, Vijay is also an accomplished author and TEDx speaker. His books, published in multiple languages, aim to further the cause of innovative engineering.
